summary: Verified TOTP issuer bug fix: otpauth_url returned by /api/auth/register (new email), /api/auth/login (mfa_setup_required path for yannick.gijbels@koodh.com), and /api/auth/2fa/reset (authenticated admin) all use issuer 'Clara Frames' with label prefix 'Clara Frames:' and query issuer=Clara Frames.
